scope: MSG03 claim7e3fbcf1-befe-4579-9d6c-ee74df6e8c51 v2/19;17 changed App/source/test files

findings.issue: Held A becomes permanently unrestorable after B changed its settings/intent/profile, even after the user explicitly saves and clears B.
findings.evidence: restorePrepared requires current ownership === capture.nextOwnership; applying/omitting settings and intent/profile changes rotate ownership permanently. restoreCaptured additionally requires the generation from original send. Thus same-session reauthentication or explicit cleanup cannot make the destination eligible again.
findings.impact: The new guard preserves B but the advertised explicit recovery path cannot restore A in the very changed-B scenario it is meant to support. The current core tests stop at returned callback and held A presence, never invoking production restorePrepared.
findings.requiredFix: Start an explicit restore from a verified empty complete destination or a still-untouched retained intent. Bind authority/ownership/generation and full draft lease to that new restore operation; preserve B and recheck after every await. Add a production-path restore success after clear/omit or reauthentication, plus a changed-during-restore rejection.
findings.ownerResponse: Owner confirmed no legal UI bypass and is implementing a narrow same-module restore seam; no second editable state store or public contract.

findings.issue: The light/dark screenshot loop changes media preference but does not change the App theme.
findings.evidence: App initializes theme once with initialTheme, then applyTheme sets data-theme/dark class/colorScheme and persisted selection; there is no media-change subscription. page.emulateMedia after mounting does not update that React theme.
findings.impact: The dark-named image can still show the light theme, so the loop does not verify the requested two themes.
findings.requiredFix: Use the real theme UI as the existing appearance journey does, assert effective data-theme/scheme, and retain the existing per-image512KiB bound before writing PNGs.

acceptanceGap.longModels: Fixture puts A/B/C near the start; it does not exercise models whose visible prefix is identical. Use valid boundary-length models with a shared prefix and differing suffix, retaining full-name inspection and bounded viewport controls. This is a correction to existing long-name acceptance, not a new task.

positiveFindings: App remains sole C owner with opaque nonserialized ownership; per-view bindings hold opening/catalog lifetime rather than a duplicate editable C.
Capture occurs before official composer detach/material preparation. Outbox and Queue deeply freeze original requested settings and retry their original key/body.
Public contracts/client matching are used, including rejection of an ACK which adds unrequested settings. Historical turn and Queue render their own frozen settings.
First-render P01 context and dialog invoker-lifetime fixes are present. New callback seam is limited to AttachmentComposer explicit restore/discard and retains default consumer behavior.
The actual installed-core failure/cancel guard uses public composer operations in production. Its controlled core tests do not prove mounted Thread or the currently broken explicit restore path.
Browser entry is isolated to MSG03 output and selector with no Recovery budget inheritance.
